{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Documentation updates in doc/REST-interface.md and release notes follow directly from the code changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not belong to docs as documentation is not the primary focus of this change."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes src/index/txindex.cpp, src/index/txindex.h, and src/index/tx_lookup_result.h to support index queries on pruned nodes.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "user request",
      "rationale": "Delivers a major user capability by resolving four long-standing issues requesting txindex support on pruned nodes (#10609 opened in 2017, #12651, #16182, and #35240). Operators of pruned nodes can now maintain a transaction index to locate historical transactions without storing the full chain."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes RPC and REST handlers in src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp, src/rpc/txoutproof.cpp, and src/rest.cpp to distinguish pruned transactions.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Updates RPC and REST endpoints to return candidate block hashes for pruned transactions rather than failing generically, allowing callers to fetch missing blocks via getblockfrompeer and retry."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test/functional/test_runner.py only to register new functional tests for the txindex feature.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The functional tests test the txindex pruning feature rather than modifying general test runner framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp only to relax the startup configuration check prohibiting -txindex with -prune.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change to startup argument handling is a mechanical consequence of enabling the txindex pruning feature."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {

    "leverage": 1
  }
}
